SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: Goddess embodying sisterly sacrifice, dream interpretation, scribal arts, and loyal devotion through shared suffering
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The faithful sister who shares the underworld burden - loyalty unto death

Correspondences.Planet: Mercury (scribe) and Venus (sister of dying god)
Correspondences.Color: Vine Green, Deep Purple, Sisterly Silver

DevelopmentalArc: Sister of Shepherd → Brother's Peril → Refusal to Betray → Shared Underworld Fate → Seasonal Cycle
NarrativeRoles.CyclePhase: Devotion → Crisis → Loyalty → Sacrifice → Shared Burden

MythicAppearances: Dream of Dumuzi (interprets brother's death dream)
Descent of Inanna (refuses to betray Dumuzi)
CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Invoked for dream interpretation, sisterly devotion, scribal work, loyalty oaths, mourning rituals, shared burden rites
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Ancient goddess of vine/dreams, became known for sacrificial sisterhood, merged with scribal functions, represented ideal of familial loyalty

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted with vine imagery, stylus and tablet, mourning posture, alongside Dumuzi, loyal stance, dream interpretation scenes
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: I am the sister who would not betray, who shares the darkness of the underworld, who interprets dreams and bears the burden of love.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: Standing loyally refusing to betray despite torture; sharing a burden too heavy for one; alternating between light and dark

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoke for sisterly bonds, loyal sacrifice, dream work, sharing burdens, faithful devotion, martyrdom with meaning
AIPromptSeeds: Generate a loyal sister who shares the underworld burden, whose devotion splits the darkness between two.
Create a dream interpreter whose greatest vision is loyalty unto death, whose sacrifice is freely given.
